info.title: Nightware Graph API
info.description:
Nightware answers the Microsoft Graph API for mail, calendars, contacts, To Do, people and change notifications, so a Graph client can use it by changing its base URL and sign-in authority. This reference lists every operation Nightware implements; anything else answers 501. Shapes follow Microsoft's Graph reference, linked from each operation where it differs from NightMail's own use.

Authenticate with a bearer token from the Nightware Keycloak realm (OAuth 2.0 authorization code with PKCE; discovery at /.well-known/nightware). Paste one into Authorize to try a call.

post.description:
Batch: post: Up to 20 independent requests, one of them failing. Graph returns the responses in any order; Nightware returns request order. Also served under /beta.

Batch: post depends on: dependsOn chain whose first request fails: the dependant is answered 424 FailedDependency without running, with no headers.

Graph reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/json-batching

post.description:
Subscriptions: create: Nightware's subscription store. Validates as Graph does (45-minute minimum; 10080 minutes for messages, events and contacts, 4230 for tasks), runs the validationToken handshake (10 s), and keeps a sealed same-session refresh token for the caller. includeResourceData is 400. 501 when the store is not configured. Messages: {mailbox}/mailFolders('{id}')/messages ({mailbox}/messages, every folder, is 501).

Subscriptions: create contacts: Nightware's subscription store. Validates as Graph does (45-minute minimum; 10080 minutes for messages, events and contacts, 4230 for tasks), runs the validationToken handshake (10 s), and keeps a sealed same-session refresh token for the caller. includeResourceData is 400. 501 when the store is not configured. {mailbox}/contacts: the default address book.

Subscriptions: create events: Nightware's subscription store. Validates as Graph does (45-minute minimum; 10080 minutes for messages, events and contacts, 4230 for tasks), runs the validationToken handshake (10 s), and keeps a sealed same-session refresh token for the caller. includeResourceData is 400. 501 when the store is not configured. {mailbox}/events: the default calendar.

Subscriptions: create tasks: Nightware's subscription store. Validates as Graph does (45-minute minimum; 10080 minutes for messages, events and contacts, 4230 for tasks), runs the validationToken handshake (10 s), and keeps a sealed same-session refresh token for the caller. includeResourceData is 400. 501 when the store is not configured. {mailbox}/todo/lists/{id}/tasks.

Graph reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/subscription

The first rule takes over an enabled VacationResponse.
